stack.android_build: Android Gradle Plugin 8.11.1, Kotlin 2.2.20 (from the stable flutter create template)
stack.storage: Hive 2.2.3: box duonap_sleep_sessions (JSON string per session) and box duonap_settings (one JSON string)

architecture: UI <-> ViewModel <-> Service <-> Repository. DTOs only in lib/data. Class prefix: DuoNap.
current_phase: Phase 1 built on branch phase-1-daily-use (on top of phase-0-first-run, neither merged). Waiting for Loshi: a full day of real use is the Phase 1 done criterion. Do not start Phase 2 without a go-ahead.
recent_changes: Phase 1 settings: DuoNapSettings (names, planned bedtime, usual wake time) in its own Hive box, with a settings screen. Replaces DuoNapFamily and the two constants in DuoNapSleepProfile.starter; defaults are the old values.

Phase 1 'woke up at...': tapping the Zgjimi row sets the morning wake-up for one baby or both. It moves an existing wake-up, ends a running night, or stores a new session of kind 'wake' (start = end). LOGIC.md section 4 updated; wakeOn counts hand wake-ups.

Phase 1 edit and delete: tapping a logged plan row opens the 'D - Dialogu' bottom sheet (baby selector, start and end at one minute per tap, delete, save). Corrections keep a sleep's date and kind hours, cannot overlap another sleep, and cannot be in the future (DuoNapSleepEditRules).

Phase 1 night view: dim screen with the time, the next wake-up and one large button per baby. Shown once night sleep is logged and before 05:00; a link switches to the day view and the header switches back.

Refactors: snapshot building moved to DuoNapTodayBuilder; shared UI pieces in lib/ui/common (pill button, round button, time stepper, Albanian error text); DuoNapClock moved to core; refresh results now ignore an older, slower refresh.

Tests: 58 passing (settings service, day history, edit rules, edit service, today builder, plus the Phase 0 tests). flutter analyze clean. Checked on the Android 16 emulator: night view, wake-up buttons, edit sheet, settings save, wake-up error message.
Phase 0: generated android/ and ios/ with flutter create on Flutter stable 3.41.9, after the flutter-3.47-candidate.0 template produced APKs that would not launch.
current_tasks: Phase 1 acceptance: both parents use it for a full day without touching code.
Phase 2: shift plan toward 19:00-07:00, earlier night after a short night.
Phase 3: Firestore sync between two phones.
Phase 4: notifications. Phase 5: history. Phase 6: optional AI logging and weekly summary.
open_decisions: Night vs nap: LOGIC.md says sleep starting 'within 60 minutes of the planned bedtime, or before 05:00' is night. The code treats any start from 60 minutes before bedtime until midnight as night. Decide which is meant (LOGIC.md section 7).

Release builds: the main AndroidManifest.xml has no INTERNET permission, so google_fonts cannot download Sora outside debug builds. Choose between adding the permission and bundling the font as an asset.
A night split by night wake-ups is several sessions; the Nata row edits only the first. A per-night list of segments may be needed (Phase 5 history is a natural place).
The shared plan follows the first baby's lines; a sleep logged only for the second baby on a line the first has not logged cannot be opened from the plan yet.
Babies' exact age is unconfirmed; needed only for an age table for new users.
The 2 h 20 min minimum last wake window rests on one observation.
